title: A  dataset  recorded  during  development  of a  tempo-based  brain-computer  music  interface
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 19 healthy participants engaged in a music-based brain-computer interface (BCMI) paradigm designed to modulate the tempo of a musical piece through intentional motor imagery. Participants either kinaesthetically imagined squeezing a ball with their right hand to increase tempo or relaxed to decrease it, over nine experimental runs including a calibration phase. The dataset supports research into affective and tempo-based brain-computer music interfaces developed under the BCMI-MIdAS project.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded at a sampling rate of 1 kHz from 19 healthy participants performing a tempo modulation task via kinaesthetic motor imagery (squeezing a ball) or relaxation. The paradigm consisted of nine runs, the first being a calibration run with 30 trials of paired increase/decrease tempo conditions, each EEG segment corresponding to a 20 s music clip.
